segments.title: June
segments.text: Hello Bandra! June is Privates Month, with a side of Out of Office. Half our members are packing for holidays, the other half want results before they go. Either way, a trainer who knows your name is the answer.

segments.title: ₹15.5L
segments.text: So, the number. Our June target for Bandra is 15.5 lakh rupees. That's 8 per cent more than last June. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 7.91 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 4.18 lakh, comebacks 2.79 lakh, and everything else 62,000. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 50 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 444 leads, 231 trials, and 50 buyers, with about 22 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 11.1 lakh rupees, which is 72 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Happy Hour (Zero Hangover, All Glutes)
segments.text: First up, Happy Hour. Zero hangover, all glutes. Privates booked between twelve and four get twenty per cent off, plus a free virtual session for every two. The only thing on tap is a trainer. The plan is 26 buyers at about 8,400, so 2.18 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members and newcomers buying private sessions.

segments.title: Private Practice
segments.text: Next, Private Practice. Ten private sessions at twenty-five per cent off, with one trainer who knows your knees better than your physio. The plan is 3 buyers at about 39,400, so 1.18 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members and newcomers buying private sessions.

segments.title: Shy Girl Starter Pack
segments.text: Then, for the nervous newcomer, the Shy Girl Starter Pack. Start with a thirty-minute private, then join class with a trainer who already knows your name. Part of the price comes off the first month. The plan is 5 buyers at about 16,200, so 81,000 rupees.

segments.title: Auto-Reply: Out of Office, Still Squatting
segments.text: And finally, for travellers, Auto-Reply, Out of Office, Still Squatting. Three months with unlimited freezes and two virtual privates for the road. They're on vacation. Their membership isn't lapsing. The plan is 12 buyers at about 57,900, so 6.94 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: No price discount; ≈9% value from virtual privates

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, the private session offers go live, and trainers build their call lists. Week two, the happy hour push fills twelve to four. Week three, travellers renew with freezes, so nobody lapses on a beach. Week four, count every conversion and brief the monsoon plan for July.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's June at Bandra. 15.5 lakh rupees, four offers, and 50 buyers to welcome. Members on holiday, memberships on track. Lovely.
